name: repo-harness-tuner
description: Generate Codex team/skill plans and continuously improve repo-local harnesses.

interface.shortDescription: Generate Codex team/skill plans and improve repo harnesses.
interface.longDescription: Repo Harness Tuner combines a team/skill factory with an adaptive harness engine. The factory side designs project-specific Codex agent roles, planned skills, orchestration docs, visible/background worker policies, repo-local team/skill artifacts, copyable Codex SKILL.md drafts, and confirmed skill installs. The engine side runs analyze, diagnose, design, tune, restructure, and evaluate loops for repo-local Codex harness design. It includes codex-harness-setup so one plugin can bootstrap, generate reviewable diffs, tune, review, evaluate, score evaluation results, track history feedback, and manage AGENTS.md, Docs/AI/*, validation guidance, human-involvement policy, Codex worker patterns, target files, and next review triggers as the project evolves.
capabilities: Codex team and skill factory planning
Repo-local agent and skill artifact generation
defaultPrompt: Design the next harness tuning step
Generate a Codex team and skill factory plan
Generate Codex skill drafts for this repo
Tune and evaluate this repo's harness
